Availability Summary

The system uses these slots to estimate planned hitcher capacity.

How to use it: Add your lessons as Class / Busy. The empty gaps will appear automatically. Press Mark Available on a gap, or drag directly across an empty row. Move blocks by dragging them and resize them by pulling the left or right edge.

Add a Time Slot

Busy slots block your time. Available slots tell the system when you are willing to hitch.
